full_prompt_en: A square watercolor cityscape shows pedestrians moving along a wet street toward a hazy cluster of old towers. The upper background is a warm pale wash, opening into soft yellow light behind blue-gray silhouettes of distant roofs and spires. Small dark birds scatter across the bright upper left. At mid-height, steep roofs and narrow facades descend along both sides of the street, their perspective lines drawing inward to a light opening in the center. The nearest building on the right is a tall cool blue-violet wall with sparse dark window marks; beneath it, slanted awnings and small warm lamps meet the sidewalk. On the left, a darker facade and projecting awning frame a tree whose autumn foliage is painted in loose ocher and amber washes. Further back, layered structures fade into mist, with a slender tower visible left of center and a darker pointed turret nearer the right. Groups of pedestrians occupy the lower middle and side edges. They are suggested mostly by dark coats, heads, and legs, with few facial details; one central figure walks toward the viewer while others gather or move away. The broad street is pale and glossy, carrying long cool blue reflections and narrow dark lines that stretch down from the figures. Watercolor blooms soften distant forms, while sharper ink-like strokes pick out roof edges, windows, awnings, and the closest silhouettes. Low warm light pours from the far end of the street, brightening the wet pavement and leaving the foreground people as nearly black shapes. The overall composition combines a strong central route, dissolving architectural depth, and restrained amber warmth inside a cool blue-gray city.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形水彩城市景色呈现行人沿湿街走向朦胧的旧城塔楼。上部背景是温暖的浅色水洗，蓝灰色远处屋顶与尖塔剪影之后散出柔和黄光。明亮的左上天空里散着细小深色飞鸟。中部，陡斜屋顶和狭窄立面沿街道两侧向远处下降，透视线汇入中央的亮处。右侧最近的建筑是一面高大的冷蓝紫色墙，只留下稀疏深色窗痕；其下斜置的雨篷和小暖灯贴近人行道。左侧较深的立面与伸出的雨篷围住一棵树，秋叶由松散的赭黄和琥珀色水洗画成。更后方的多层建筑退入薄雾，中央偏左可见一座细塔，偏右则有较深的尖顶角楼。几组行人占据下部中间及两侧边缘。他们主要由深色外套、头部与腿部暗示，面部细节很少；一名中央人物朝观看者走来，其他人聚集或背向远去。宽阔街面浅亮湿润，承载冷蓝色长反光，以及从人物脚下向下伸展的狭长深线。水彩渗化使远景形体柔化，较锐利的墨线般笔触则挑出屋顶边、窗户、雨篷和最近的人形。低处暖光从街道尽头涌来，照亮湿润路面，让前景行人化为近黑色形体。整体构图结合强烈的中央通道、逐渐消融的建筑纵深，以及冷蓝灰城市中的克制琥珀色暖意。
style_prompt_en: The watercolor treatment combines large transparent blue-gray washes with selective dark linear accents and small concentrations of amber. Broad pale areas remain open, while darker vertical strokes gather around the sides and lower portion to establish depth. Pigment blooms and diffused edges make distant layers recede into haze; closer forms retain firmer broken contours. Thin dragged marks and diluted reflections extend downward across a smooth, light-toned plane, giving the composition a luminous base. Cool violet, slate blue, and charcoal dominate, with warm ocher and gold placed sparingly as points of visual temperature. The light appears low and diffused through mist, so highlights spread across broad areas rather than forming hard glossy spots. Repeated upright shapes are balanced by a central corridor of negative space and long horizontal roof rhythms. The image feels fluid, atmospheric, and quietly structured through value contrast more than exact detail.
style_prompt_zh: 这种水彩处理把大面积透明蓝灰水洗与选择性的深色线性重音、少量琥珀色集中区域结合起来。宽阔的浅色区域保持开放，较深的竖向笔触聚在两侧及下部以建立纵深。颜料渗化和扩散边缘使远层退入薄雾；较近形体则保留更坚实、断续的轮廓。纤细的拖曳痕迹与稀释反光沿光滑的浅色平面向下伸展，为构图提供明亮底部。冷紫、石板蓝与炭灰占主导，暖赭和金色作为少量温度重音放置。光线显得低斜而被雾扩散，因此高光铺成较宽的区域，而非坚硬的亮斑。重复的直立形体与中央负空间通道、绵长的水平线节奏取得平衡。图像流动、富有氛围感，并主要通过明度对比而非精确细节保持安静的结构。
theme_en: Pedestrians on a luminous wet street beneath a hazy old skyline
theme_zh: 朦胧旧城天际线下明亮湿街上的行人
name: Thomas Schaller
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
